step1_analysis.circuit_type: Bias Circuit (Current Mirror with Decoupling Capacitors)
step1_analysis.description: A PMOS-to-NMOS current mirror bias circuit that generates an NMOS bias voltage (VBN) from a PMOS bias voltage (VBP). It includes MOS capacitors (XM2, XM4) to filter out noise and stabilize the bias voltages, which is critical for reducing phase noise in the VCO.

paper_reference.title: Techniques for Phase Noise Suppression in Recirculating DLLs

I_bias.description: DC bias current flowing through the current mirror stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the square-law model for the PMOS current source (XM3) with VBP=0.99V and VDD=1.8V.

VBN_DC.description: Generated DC bias voltage for the NMOS transistors in the VCO.

sky130_expected.calculation: VBN = Vthn + sqrt(2 * Id / (un*Cox * W/L)) = 0.42 + sqrt(2 * 38u / (270u * 10)) = 0.587 V
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected NMOS (XM1) converts the mirrored current into the VBN bias voltage.

Power.description: Total static power consumption of the bias stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the bias current and the 1.8V supply voltage.

AC_Gain.description: Small-signal low-frequency gain from VBP to VBN, indicating how noise on VBP transfers to VBN.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm3 / gm1. gm3 = 2*Id/Vov3 = 194uS. gm1 = 2*Id/Vov1 = 455uS. Gain = 194/455 = 0.42 V/V = -7.5 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the ratio of the transconductances of the PMOS current source and the NMOS diode load.

Bandwidth.description: 3dB bandwidth of the VBP to VBN transfer function, limited by the MOS filter capacitors.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * C_total). Rout = 1/gm1 = 2.2kOhm. C_total ~ 30fF. BW ~ 2.4 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the small-signal resistance of XM1 and the parasitic/MOS capacitance at the VBN node.

Filter_Capacitance.description: Decoupling capacitance provided by the MOS capacitors (XM2, XM4).

sky130_expected.calculation: C = W * L * Cox = 5u * 0.5u * 8.6fF/um^2 = 21.5 fF per device
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports large nF capacitors, likely for the main loop filter. The extracted devices here are small local decoupling caps.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point (bias current, VBN voltage, power) and AC transfer characteristics (gain, bandwidth) of the bias circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 VBN VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 LABEL_NET_0 VBN LABEL_NET_0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VBN VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND VBP GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBP VBP 0 0.99 ac 1
* LABEL_NET_0 acts as a reference/ground for the NMOS capacitor
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9

.control
* DC Operating Point Analysis
op
let i_bias = -i(VVDD)
let power = i_bias * 1.8
let vbn_dc = v(VBN)
print i_bias power vbn_dc

* AC Analysis for Transfer Function and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(VBN)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='max_gain-3' fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
